summary: Approved raw XML storage and responsive document I/O implemented and verified in vite-office.
findings: Worker filtering, bounded graph capture/adoption, metadata-only listings and compact empty-cell ODF spans address the observed blocking paths. User and portable 5000-row browser probes pass without page errors.
residual_risks: Earlier ZIP browser records are intentionally not migrated; existing unsupported ODF feature limits remain. Full all-app coverage was outside the focused verification contract.
